top.name: Voltaic Lattice
top.rules_text: Deploy a Lattice Node on an empty tile within 2 (6 HP). Friendly constructs within 2 tiles gain +2 damage each round.

bottom.name: Disruption Field
bottom.rules_text: Project a disruption zone (radius 2) on target tile for 3 turns: enemies inside take 3 damage and are slowed each round.
